jobs.name: PQ network and witness (ubuntu-24.04-arm, head)

steps.name: Require retained source and claim controls
Prepare the independently pinned OpenSSL provider
Record compiler, exact locked graph and formatting
Execute every required native effect and rejection control
Require admitted migration handoff and checkpoint endpoint ownership
Execute anchored NPQ6 migration and source-preservation controls
Refuse classical submit recovery for retained PQ network owners
Require native TLS and ordinary binary controls from actual registries
Require the explicit TLS witness CLI controls from the actual binary
Preserve native control records before the complete regression
Preserve the complete original Node library regression suite
Check strict Clippy without rewriting source
Observe complete component costs with unchanged native budgets
